exists out/main.go

cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/arenaimport

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println(oneline(), first(), ungrouped(), only(), commented(), line(), kept())
}

-- m/oneline.lgo --
package main

import ("fmt"; "logos/arena")

type cell struct{ v int }

func oneline() string {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[cell](r)
	p.v = 1
	return fmt.Sprint(p.v)
}

-- m/first.lgo --
package main

import ("logos/arena"; "strconv")

func first() string {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[cell](r)
	p.v = 2
	return strconv.Itoa(p.v)
}

-- m/ungrouped.lgo --
package main

import /* arena */ "logos/arena"; import "os"

func ungrouped() int {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[cell](r)
	p.v = 3
	return p.v + len(os.Args[:0])
}

-- m/only.lgo --
package main

import "logos/arena"

func only() int {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[cell](r)
	p.v = 4
	return p.v
}

-- m/comment.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt" // format
	"logos/arena" /* region */ // arena
)

func commented() string {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[cell](r)
	p.v = 5
	return fmt.Sprint(p.v)
}

-- m/linecomment.lgo --
package main

import // arena
	"logos/arena"; import "strings"

func line() string {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[cell](r)
	p.v = 6
	return strings.Repeat("6", p.v-5)
}

-- m/kept.lgo --
package main

import ("logos/arena"; "sort")

var keptRegs [1]arena.Region

func kept() int {
	p := arena.New[cell](keptRegs[0])
	p.v = 7
	return sort.SearchInts([]int{1, 2, 3}, p.v)*0 + p.v
}
